personality_one_liner: An intense, gamified powerlifting command center where every PR feels like leveling up in a gritty cyberpunk anime.

spacing.rule: Dense, athletic spacing to keep live stats visible without scrolling. Tight internal padding for list rows, generous padding for hero sections.

do's: Use subtle glowing borders (borderStrong with drop shadow) instead of glass for elevated elements.
dont's: Do not use blur or frosted glass; it softens the UI too much for a hardcore cyberpunk aesthetic.

screens.name: Onboarding & Auth
screens.purpose: Immerse the user immediately into the dark, tech-heavy aesthetic while verifying Skool/Premium status.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image of a dark powerlifting gym. Sharp, angled auth inputs. 'Enter the Circle' primary CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Act as the 'Mission Briefing' screen displaying the athlete's next workout, current rank, and progress.

states.loading: Skeleton grids with a sweeping blue highlight.
states.empty: No active program - 'Select a Protocol' CTA.
states.error: Data sync failed message with a mechanical retry button.

screens.layout: Hero section featuring user's anime avatar and rank badge. Quick-start workout card. Modular grid for weekly XP and Consistency tracking.

screens.name: Workout Logger
screens.purpose: Frictionless, live operational surface to track heavy lifts with extreme precision.
screens.layout: Bottom-sheet overlay for active session. List rows for sets with tabular numbers. Plate-weight steppers for quick increments. Vertical 'voltage meter' progress bar tracking workout completion. Sticky 'Finish Workout' CTA.

screens.name: Leaderboards
screens.purpose: High-stakes gamified ranking across Consistency, Strength, and BW Ratio.
screens.layout: Three-tier podium display for top 3 athletes with gold/silver/bronze glowing borders. Below, ranked tables using flexbox rows, monospaced rank numbers, and right-aligned performance metrics. Tabs to switch between the 3 leaderboards.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: A digital dossier showcasing the athlete's achievements, PRs, and anime persona.
screens.layout: Header with glowing anime avatar and Skool/Premium status badge. Grid of earned milestone badges (e.g., 135, 225, 315 plates). Embedded progress charts with neon cyan lines on dark backgrounds.

screens.name: Athlete's Center & The Room
screens.purpose: Premium AI workout builder and elite-only chat.
screens.layout: Chat interface with stark tech typography. AI center features terminal-like text inputs and glowing generated program cards.

auth_bg.alt: A man prepares to lift a barbell in a dimly lit gym environment

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute the UI using a 'Dark-First Utility' aesthetic fused with Cyberpunk. Avoid soft, rounded corners; use strict, angular radius tokens (sm/md max) for a faceted, tech-heavy feel.

The color palette relies on Deep Black (#050508) as the root canvas, with Neon Cyan (#00E5FF) and Royal Blue (#0055FF) used exclusively for glowing accents, CTAs, and active states. Do NOT use default Material indigo.
Typography must drive the gaming aesthetic: Use Rajdhani for all headers, numbers, and stats to give an HUD/terminal feel. Use IBM Plex Sans for readability in body text and workout logs.

Implement the Workout Logger for speed: use plate-weight steppers instead of standard text inputs to make rack-side logging frictionless. Use tabular numbers (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) in all set/rep/weight rows to prevent shifting.
Leaderboards should use a podium structural pattern for the top 3 (Gold/Silver/Bronze highlights) and a dense, monospaced tabular list for ranks below.
Instead of traditional glassmorphism (which softens the UI), use stark borders and drop shadows mimicking 'neon glow' for elevated elements and active states.
Ensure the 'Premium' and 'Skool Member' visual states are highly distinct, using exclusive neon badges or avatar borders.
